notes.title: Casino update full release.
notes.content: The casino has been added to the main game branch. Fixed several bugs with the casino and also with the main game. The casino should be close to final state, but the desert town will possibly have other events added like a race thru the town. Next, I will be working on the physics and handling of the buggy and track design. This will be a major update and will take some time because it will affect much of the game, such as AI design. Follow on Discord for more frequent updates.

notes.title: Test the latest beta build.
notes.content: Happy New Year! Just released a test branch to the game. It adds a desert town with a casino. The casino only has slot machines that use championship points. If you win big, you can skip races and still win and unlock levels. If you play during a single race, no changes will be carried over to the championship, unless you set a new lap record during the single race. To find the town and casino, start race 11, drive thru the first checkpoint and keep going straight, then after a while, look for the town off to your left. It can be found on any desert level that doesn't have vegetation(bushes or cactus). To select the test branch, right click on ORR in your library. Select Properties, and then the beta tab. Select Test from the drop down box. The level hasn't been tested and is missing sound effects for the slots, so use with caution because it may contain game breaking bugs.

notes.title: ORR delayed.
notes.content: ORR Early Access has been delayed again. I have been in an auto accident and am injured. Being a solo developer, if I can't work, nothing gets done. I had hoped to still release on October 30, but was not able to complete enough work to justify a release. I will try to release as soon as possible, but can't set a date at this time. I do plan to open the ORR discord channel and will be looking for people who want to test the game before Early Access release. Thank you for your patience and stay tuned for more announcements.
